Class Client

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.net.control.Client
public class Client extends Object
Represents a client connected to the server, either via socket or RMI. Manages communication and associates the specific id and truckerController to the client, in addiction with its lastPongTime to see if it's still active.
